mapper.select: SELECT EV.stock_type AS type, EV.stock_code AS code, EV.名称 AS itemName, EV.貸出 AS loanCount, EV.在庫 AS returnCount, EV.不明 AS unknownCount, EV.合計 AS totalCount, FROM equip_list_view EV WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT IFNULL( GCM.value_1, '1') AS windowSize FROM generic_code_master GCM WHERE 1 = 1 AND GCM.type_key = #{type} AND GCM.code = #{code}
